segs.name: AI Core
segs.desc: You. Consciousness AND compute pool: each running filesystem operation claims one thread; at capacity, new ops wait. Damage glitches the whole screen, and below 50% you think one thing at a time. Cannot be deleted; heal it with Repair, paid in REPAIR CHARGE.

segs.name: Engine I/O
segs.desc: Your link to the engine. The more damaged it is, the weaker and shakier the engine. Repair heals it, paid in REPAIR CHARGE; the engine is off while it repairs.

segs.name: Autopilot
segs.desc: Points the ship for the W/A/S/D presets. Badly damaged, the presets stop working: turn by hand with Q/E.

segs.name: Sensor Interp
segs.desc: Turns raw sensor data into the predicted path. Damaged: the readouts are only ≈ right. Badly damaged: PATH UNCERTAIN.

segs.name: Nav Plotter
segs.desc: Draws the NAV PLOT. Without it the plot shows NO SIGNAL.

segs.name: Telemetry
segs.desc: Feeds the ship's numbers to your screens. Below 60% the digits start to scramble.

segs.name: AI Comms
segs.desc: Your radio to ARRIVAL CONTROL, and your way out: transmission to the next ship, or BEAM OUT.

segs.name: AUTOBURN.skl
segs.desc: A skill trained between ships, sharpened by braking at ▼ yourself. Press [B] near ▼ and it flies the capture for you, into the ring or until a trim is left, even while you are in the MIND. Works while healthy (50% or more). It can be eaten.

segs.name: Scan
segs.desc: Filesystem utility. Reveals the integrity of a ship file. Your own files you can always see; the ship's damage stays hidden until scanned.
A file you didn't pack. Locked. No flight effect.

segs.name: Repair Charge
segs.desc: Transmitted alongside the AI. Every point a Repair heals costs charge (bigger files cost more). Spent blocks stay empty until Repair v2 squeezes them out; when the last point is spent the blocks become free space. Deleting it frees the space and loses the charge.
